stem: In what way does the setting affect the development of the plot?

options.label: A
options.text: The setting causes the characters to change their opinion about a topic.

options.label: B
options.text: The setting gives the characters an opportunity to enjoy the weather.

options.label: C
options.text: The setting allows the characters to understand one another better.

options.label: D
options.text: The setting requires the characters to rely on someone else for information.
